_comment: Keyboard keys, by pygame key name (pygame.key.key_code). skillBar = one key per action-bar slot, in order; it must have as many keys as skills.json barSlots. Which SKILL sits in each slot is the player's choice (hover a skill in the trees and press the key, or click a slot) and is saved with the character. Default keys follow GDD 12.3 (skills 1–6). An action may list several keys. The options menu (M7-05) will edit this file.
